grammarFocus: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that。
title: My New Desk
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和问题都是模拟材料，不是官方雅思考试。请仔细阅读短文，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage: This is my new desk. It is big and brown. That is a chair. It is small and black. This is a lamp. It is on the desk. That is a book. It is red. This is a pen. It is blue. That is a bag. It is on the chair. This is my phone. It is new.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“It is big and brown.”，所以书桌是棕色的。
短文中说“That is a chair. It is small and black.”，所以椅子是又小又黑的。
questions.evidence: That is a chair. It is small and black.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“This is a lamp. It is on the desk.”，所以台灯在书桌上。
questions.evidence: This is a lamp. It is on the desk.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“That is a book. It is red.”，所以书是红色的。
questions.evidence: That is a book. It is red.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“This is a pen. It is blue.”，所以钢笔是蓝色的。
questions.evidence: This is a pen. It is blue.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“That is a bag. It is on the chair.”，所以包在椅子上。
questions.evidence: That is a bag. It is on the chair.

questions.prompt: The phone is ________. (用短文中的词填空)
questions.explanation: 短文中说“This is my phone. It is new.”，所以手机是新的。
questions.evidence: This is my phone. It is new.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“This is my new desk. It is big and brown.”，所以书桌是又大又棕的。
questions.evidence: This is my new desk. It is big and brown.

grammar.title: This / That; a / an; is
grammar.explanation: this 指近处的单个人或物，that 指远处的单个人或物。第一次介绍一个未特指的单数可数名词时，常用 a 或 an：后面的读音以元音音素开头用 an，否则用 a。这里比较的是 a/an，不是已经特指的 the。he、she、it 或表示单个人/物的第三人称名词作主语时，be 动词用 is；I 用 am，you 用 are。
grammar.example: This is a lamp. That is a chair.

questions.prompt: 用指示代词 this 或 that 指近处的书：________ is a book.
用指示代词 this 或 that 指远处的苹果：________ is an apple.
第一次介绍一个未特指的鸡蛋，请用不定冠词 a 或 an 填空：This is ________ egg.
questions.explanation: egg 以元音音素开头，所以用 an。

questions.prompt: 第一次介绍一支未特指的笔，请用不定冠词 a 或 an 填空：That is ________ pen.
questions.explanation: pen 以辅音音素开头，所以用 a。

part1: What is this? (point to a nearby object)
What is that? (point to a far object)
speaking.part2: Describe an object near you. You should say: what it is, its color, where it is, and if it is new or old.

transfer.writing: Write 2-8 simple sentences about things in your room. Use this, that, a, an, and is. Example: This is a desk. It is brown.
